name: Docker Compose
code_template:
version: '3.8'
services:
  api:
    build: .
    ports:
      - '8000:8000'
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:pass@db:5432/app
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: postgres:15
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=user
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=pass
      - POSTGRES_DB=app
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
volumes:
  pgdata:
